summary: Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of First and Refunding Mortgage Bonds in three series due 2031, 2036, and 2056. The filing is a routine debt issuance; it discloses no acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation event. Key terms—principal amounts, interest rates, maturity dates—are placeholder only. The bonds are secured by a lien on properties and franchises, with optional redemption provisions and no sinking fund. No trading market listing is planned. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
